items.headline: ₹50 crore fraud: SC orders CBI probe
items.blurb: The Supreme Court ordered a CBI probe into the alleged ₹50 crore Shankerpura fraud case after victims petitioned for a central investigation.

items.headline: Global enterprises commit $20 billion at Mangaluru summit
items.blurb: Invest Karnataka Global Investors Meet sessions in Mangaluru saw enterprises pledge about $20 billion in investments across manufacturing, IT and logistics, officials said.

items.headline: MSME STATE CONFERENCE FOR MANGALURU
items.blurb: The Karnataka government will host a three-day MSME State Conference in Mangaluru from November 5 to 7 at Hotel Ocean Pearl, with Commerce and Industries Minister M.B. Patil, MSME Development Corporation chair Padmanabha Balakrishna and Bantwal MLA Rajesh Naik among speakers; organisers said entrepreneurs need better access to finance and awareness of government schemes.

items.headline: COUPLE'S DEATH RAISES SUSPICION OF ACID ATTACK
items.blurb: Dr Arun Mascarenhas and his wife Dr Lavanya were found dead at their Bajpe home after a dispute with labourers; police arrested Santhosh and are investigating whether acid was used.

items.headline: Contractors to pay for poor quality of Smart City work: Mayor
items.blurb: Mangaluru Mayor Sudheer Shetty Kannur said contractors will bear the cost of redoing substandard Smart City project works after inspections found poor quality in several wards.

items.headline: Moral policing: Seven-member fact-finding panel to tour Udupi
items.blurb: A seven-member fact-finding committee formed after moral policing incidents in Udupi will visit the district from October 16; members include former judges, academics and activists named by the state government.

items.headline: Protest in Ghewarabail over groundwater contamination
items.blurb: Residents protested in Ghewarabail, Uttara Kannada, after a farmer's suicide blamed on polluted groundwater near an industrial unit; officials promised tests.

items.headline: ACCUSED FOUND DEAD IN UDUPI JAIL
items.blurb: Nagaraj P.U., 42, an undertrial found hanging in Udupi district jail, was earlier accused in a criminal case; police registered an unnatural-death report.

items.headline: Newborn baby dumped in bushes dead in Sullia
items.blurb: A newborn girl was found dead in bushes at Sullia taluk on Tuesday after a woman delivered in a toilet and abandoned the infant. Police registered a case at Sullia Rural police station and are investigating.

items.headline: Kundapur MLA hands over houses to 52 flood-hit families
items.blurb: The Kundapur MLA handed newly built houses to 52 families affected by last year's floods.

items.headline: 'No moral right to stay in party', DKS tells rebel MLAs to quit
items.blurb: Deputy Chief Minister D K Shivakumar said rebel Congress MLAs have no moral right to remain in the party and should resign and face by-elections, referring to legislators who skipped the legislature party meeting.

items.headline: Purple Line Metro trial in Dec '25, operational by Aug '26
items.blurb: BMRCL said trial runs on the 13.71-km Purple Line extension from Challaghatta to Kadabagere will begin in December 2025 and commercial operations are targeted by August 2026.

items.headline: Karnataka to conduct festival audit ahead of Deepavali
items.blurb: Home Minister G. Parameshwara said the government will audit firecracker stalls and crowd arrangements before Deepavali.

items.headline: TAX CUT ON LIQUOR TO BOOST REVENUE, SAYS EXCISE MINISTER
items.blurb: After a review chaired by Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, Excise Minister N.S. Boseraju said abolishing the 15% import duty and offering a 30% concession rate on liquor is aimed at boosting state revenue, noting liquor licences have been frozen since 2008.

items.headline: 3.2 lakh aspirants to take KPSC exam
items.blurb: About 3.2 lakh candidates will appear for the Karnataka Public Service Commission gazetted probationers preliminary examination on October 19 across the state; the commission issued admit cards and exam centre details.

items.headline: Farmers to get ₹10,000 per acre for FRA land
items.blurb: Tribal Affairs Minister Jual Oram said farmers cultivating Forest Rights Act land will receive ₹10,000 per acre annually, credited directly to bank accounts.

items.headline: ED attaches assets worth ₹59.89 crore in gold smuggling case
items.blurb: The Enforcement Directorate attached ₹59.89 crore in assets of prime accused Ibrahim Koya and others in the Kerala gold smuggling probe linked to 30 kg seized at Thiruvananthapuram airport in July 2020.

items.headline: CAA hearing in SC today
items.blurb: The Supreme Court listed hearings on petitions challenging the Citizenship (Amendment) Act.

items.headline: KHARGE ASKS PM TO REVIVE OLD PENSION SCHEME
items.blurb: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi demanding restoration of the Old Pension Scheme for central government employees, the national brief said.

items.headline: GST on rice cut from 5% to 0% from Oct. 22
items.blurb: GST Council reduced tax on rice to nil from October 22, lowering retail prices.

items.headline: 37 killed, 30 injured, 10 missing: Gaza school strike death toll rises
items.blurb: Health officials said at least 37 people were killed, 30 injured and 10 missing after an Israeli strike on a school sheltering displaced people in Gaza; Israel said it targeted militants operating from the site.

items.headline: Trump raises new tariffs on Chinese imports
items.blurb: Former US President Donald Trump announced additional tariffs on Chinese goods if elected, escalating trade rhetoric ahead of the presidential campaign.

items.headline: Nobel Economics Prize to trio for innovation theory
items.blurb: The Nobel Prize in economic sciences was awarded to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt for research on innovation, technology and sustained economic growth.

items.headline: India, E.U. agree to restart FTA talks
items.blurb: India and the European Union agreed to resume free trade agreement negotiations, aiming to conclude talks by late 2026.

items.headline: Russia targets Kyiv with drones
items.blurb: Russia launched drone strikes on Kyiv, Ukrainian officials said, as the war entered another winter campaign.

items.headline: India beat Australia in T20 series opener
items.blurb: India defeated Australia in the first T20 international of the series.

items.headline: India aim to seal T20I series against Australia
items.blurb: India face Australia in the deciding T20I seeking a series win after splitting the first two matches, the Sports Trail lead said.

items.headline: INDIA BEAT AUSTRALIA IN 2ND WOMEN'S ODI
items.blurb: India defeated Australia in the second women's ODI to level the series, with a centurion leading the chase, the Sports Trail reported.

items.headline: Afghans face big loss as Pakistan knocks them out of T20 WC
items.blurb: Pakistan defeated Afghanistan in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, eliminating Afghanistan from the tournament and keeping Pakistan's semi-final hopes alive.

items.headline: Chess: Gukesh wins Sinquefield leg
items.blurb: D. Gukesh won his Sinquefield Cup game against a top-ten opponent.
